title: BFF vote bypasses election eligibility rules + dues restrictions
expected: Residents gated by election_eligibility_rules (KYC/payment/resident_types) or active dues restriction must be refused,matching Go CastVote
actual: Route checked only residency+window;ineligible and dues-restricted voters could cast via the mobile path
root_cause: Parallel BFF implementation never consulted the rules/restriction tables the Go path enforces

title: BFF resident context ignores banned/deleted membership
expected: Banned or soft-deleted members must fail closed (ESTATE-AUTHZ-003 parity with Go assertRoles)
actual: Three copies of getResidentContext lacked banned_at/deleted_at filters;banned/deleted residents could still vote,pay dues,RSVP,read minutes
root_cause: Helper duplicated 3x without the authz columns;drift vs the fixed Go helper

title: Ballot secrecy violated by schema + receipt API
expected: Participation receipt verifies a vote without revealing candidate selection;voter->choice unlinkable
actual: election_votes stores (election_id,voter_id,candidate_id) in one row;GET /ballot echoed candidate_id;mobile receipt displayed the choice
root_cause: Single-table ballot design;API returned the stored choice verbatim

title: Dues BFF double-charge: no atomic invoice claim across different Idempotency-Keys
expected: One receipt+one debit per invoice regardless of concurrent keys (Go payDues FOR UPDATE parity)
actual: Two requests with DIFFERENT keys both passed the unpaid check,both debited the wallet,both wrote receipts
root_cause: Status check -> debit -> insert sequence had no atomic claim;partial-unique index only deduped same-key replays

title: Realtor BFF same double-debit race + foreign-key receipt misattribution
expected: One payment per invoice;foreign Idempotency-Key replay must not settle a different invoice
actual: Cross-key concurrent pay double-debited (RPC has FOR UPDATE but no unpaid-status guard);same-key/different-invoice replay returned the other invoice's receipt
root_cause: No pre-debit claim;RPC lacks unpaid check;fast-path keyed on key only

title: Live per-candidate tally exposed to all residents mid-poll
expected: Tally restricted until results published (Go GetResults:closed/tallied only)
actual: mapElection computed and returned candidate vote counts for every election state including live
root_cause: BFF mapping ignored the tally-release rule the Go path enforces

title: Admin resident arrears always zero (wrong join column)
expected: Arrears = SUM(open invoice amount) per resident
actual: Subquery joined di.resident_id=r.id (estate_residents.id) while resident_id stores auth user_id -> 0 for everyone
root_cause: ID-type confusion between resident row id and user id

title: BFF meeting create allows any resident vs Go estate_admin-only
actual: POST creates meetings for any resident;Go CreateMeeting requires estate_admin
root_cause: Divergent authz between parallel surfaces;mobile ships a resident create screen (product decision needed)

title: Realtor PAYSTACK channel unimplemented
root_cause: Disclosed out-of-scope gap from the earlier exploit fix

title: Webhook signature/ordering seam is platform-owned
actual: HMAC verification + dispatch live in platform-owned code;lane records,platform lane owns execution

title: Secret-ballot schema split required (voter->choice unlinkability)
actual: election_votes couples voter_id+candidate_id;API now sealed but DB still linkable
root_cause: Requires schema change -> pending migration + writer re-point

title: No partial/over-payment support on dues or rent
expected: Partial payments allocate accurately to residual;overpay handled per policy
actual: Both paths reject non-exact amounts;no paid_amount/residual tracking

title: Resident election tally 500s when a candidate has no bio
expected: GetResults returns the per-candidate tally for a closed election
actual: pgx "cannot scan NULL into *string" (col: bio) — the resident-facing tally failed for any election with a candidate whose bio is NULL
root_cause: election_candidates.bio is nullable but the query selected it without COALESCE, unlike the admin tally which already coalesced it

title: Election governance workflow absent (roll/nomination/quorum/tie-break/complaint/cancellation/poll type)
expected: An estate can publish a roll, vet candidates, require a quorum, break a tie by rule, entertain complaints, recount, cancel a poll and run a non-binding vote
actual: The domain had a ballot plus an eligibility switch: elections went straight to 'open', candidates were invented at create time, quorum/tie-break did not exist, no roll/challenge/nomination/complaint/recount entity existed, cancellation was unreachable and every vote was implicitly binding
root_cause: Not a bug but a missing subsystem — each gap was a P0 UAT row that could only be closed by building the entity, so this is recorded as one umbrella defect for the slice

title: BFF election create bypasses the draft governance workflow
expected: POST /api/v1/elections creates a draft that must be configured, approved and opened through the governance service
actual: The BFF insert hardcodes status='open', so an election created from the app can never be configured (every governance verb refuses a non-draft) and skips roll freeze + candidate certification
root_cause: The mobile/BFF create path predates the governance workflow and was not re-pointed in this slice; the Go path and admin console are correct. Needs a product decision on whether the app gets a stripped-down governance wizard or defers creation to the console
